cues.en: Let's have a closer look at numbers and strings in this module.
Now obviously we worked with both a lot throughout this course and we'll not start from scratch,
instead we'll have a tiny look behind the scenes and dive into some advanced features or features we
simply haven't really worked with thus far. To be precise in this module, we'll have a look at numbers,
how they are actually represented internally and why we sometimes end up with strange results in certain
We'll have a look at the global number and math objects or constructor functions and what we can do with
those and we'll also dive into strings again and there, also revisit template literals because it
turns out with those we can do more than what we did thus far.
